description: Development of the road section from the Kerewalapitiya Expressway Entrance to the Elakanda Road, located within the Wattala Industrial Zone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Litro Gas Company, the Petroleum Company, and the Ceylon Electricity Board and several projects approved by the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka have been established on a land area of 400 acres, developed by the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation in the Kerawalapitiya area. Although the Road Development Authority had initiated a project in the year 2021 to develop the road section of 2.2 km from the Kerawalapitiya Expressway Entrance to the Elakanda Road, which is located in the middle of the industrial zone and used as an access to the expressway, its construction work has not been completed due to the economic crisis which prevailed in the country. The need to expeditiously develop that road section, which is seriously dilapidated at present, has been identified. Accordingly, taking into account a proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development, approval of the Cabinet was granted to expeditiously renovate the said road section to make it suitable for transportation, and thereafter to conduct a formal study to widen the said road as a long-term solution, and to develop the same using the provisions allocated under the Medium-Term Budgetary Framework.
